purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 795 Jamnagar (city code 2647); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
registryBasis: Official Government of Gujarat materials identify two Jamnagar City Survey Offices (Jamnagar-1 and Jamnagar-2) and the district’s land-records service. Jamnagar Municipal Corporation publishes a city map/GIS page, but its FAQ describes utility layers rather than parcel polygons and its property assessment services are account-oriented. The local city-survey registry is verified; no safe anonymous geometry route is.

officialSources.observation: Official district portal describes land records, cadastral survey basis and online record-of-rights/mutation services in Jamnagar district.
Government of Gujarat Informatics procurement document lists Jamnagar-1 and Jamnagar-2 City Survey Offices.
Official JMC FAQ references city-survey documents for municipal planning processes and a city map; no downloadable parcel feature schema is documented.
Official Gujarati FAQ describes map tools and public utility layers; it does not describe full parcel geometry. Tax services request assessment identifiers and were not queried.

searchQueries.result: Official Jamnagar district and Gujarat Revenue sources establish land-record/property-card services. A Gujarat government scanning tender names Jamnagar-1 and Jamnagar-2 City Survey Offices. JMC publishes a city map and GIS application; its FAQ describes public-utility layers, while property-tax assessment is account-oriented. No parcel geometry schema was verified.

searchQueries.result: જામનગર જિલ્લા સત્તાવાર land-records પાનું રેકોર્ડ ઓફ રાઈટ્સ સેવા દર્શાવે છે; ગુજરાત સરકારના દસ્તાવેજમાં Jamnagar-1 અને Jamnagar-2 City Survey Offices સૂચિબદ્ધ છે. JMC FAQ શહેરના નકશા માટેના નકશા સાધનો અને જાહેર utility layers સમજાવે છે; મિલકત કર શોધ વ્યક્તિગત assessment સંદર્ભિત છે. કોઈ parcel geometry/schema query કરવામાં આવી નથી.

accessReview.reason: No public anonymous parcel feature layer with a verified safe geometry-and-ID schema was found. JMC’s public map description covers civic utility layers, and assessment lookup would involve account-specific information; neither was queried for parcel data.
